title: Acropolis: Genghis against the Immortals
lede: The Golden Khaganate under Genghis Khan against Ardashir the Flamebringer and his Javidan Immortals, on the Acropolis. The closest of six: the Khaganate led after three rounds, then Ardashir and the Immortals destroyed both Stormrider squads and a burning field on the centre did the rest, 34 to 25 in Round 6. Over the six battles the Immortals won 5 to 1, on average 33.2 VP to 21.7, and dealt more than three times the damage.
result_line: Flamebringer's Immortals win on Victory Points, 34 to 25
deployment: The Khaganate set up along rows 12 and 13: Genghis Khan leading the Khesig Guards at (5,12), the Black Shaman with Stormrider 1 at (3,13), Stormrider 2 at (11,13), the Nerge Outriders at (9,13) and the Tamga-Bound Troops at (6,12). The Atashid Empire set up on row 2: Ardashir leading the Javidan Immortals at (9,2), the Mobad with Shieldbearers 1 at (11,2), Shieldbearers 2 at (5,2), the Adur Furnace Guard at (3,2), and the two Sagdid Hound-Keeper squads at (7,2) and (10,2).

1.title: The riders reach the ground first

feed.text: Neither side spends CP. Missions: FOCUSED FIRE for the Khaganate, DEEP REACH for the Empire. Primaries: BLEED THEM WHITE for Genghis, ERADICATE THE FOE for Ardashir.

Every unit Advances. Stormrider 1 and the Black Shaman reach the centre at (6,8), Genghis and the Khesig Guards the west at (2,8), Stormrider 2 the east side at (11,9). The Immortals come up to (9,5), the Shieldbearers to (8,5) and (10,4).
The Khaganate holds the centre and the west. Genghis's Army 5, Flamebringer's Immortals 0.

Genghis's Scouting Order on the Nerge Outriders spots the Mobad and Shieldbearers 1; he requisitions a Tamga-Bound squad. Ardashir spends 3 CP on Judgement of the Sun, which BLINDS Genghis and his Khesig Guards, and requisitions a Shieldbearer squad.
Ardashir and the Immortals charge Stormrider 2 on the east at (12,8); the riders Fall Back in disorder (3 HP). COORDINATED PUSH completes for the Empire (+2).
The Tamga-Bound Troops shoot the Shieldbearers for 3. The Black Shaman's Chant of the Kindling raises Genghis's hunger.
The Khaganate holds the centre and the west, the Empire the east, with DEEP REACH (+3). Genghis's Army 10, Flamebringer's Immortals 7.

3.title: The Immortals cut down the Tamga-Bound

feed.text: The requisitioned Tamga-Bound charge into the Immortals on the east at (12,7); a requisitioned Shieldbearer squad charges the west at (1,7).
The Immortals take 18 HP off the Tamga-Bound and the Shieldbearers 6 more; Stormrider 1 shoots into that melee and its stray shot finishes them. Genghis completes STRONGPOINT (+1).
Ardashir and the Immortals charge again at (12,7); Genghis and the Khesig Guards charge Shieldbearers 2 in the centre at (6,6).

Genghis and the Khesig Guards destroy Shieldbearers 2. Ardashir takes 13 HP off Stormrider 2 and the Immortals destroy it. The Mobad's Sunburst sets a BURNING FIELD over (6,7), one square in every direction, which covers the centre objective; the field and the BURNED it leaves take 16.5 HP off the Khaganate over the next rounds.
The Empire scores ERADICATE THE FOE (+2). Flamebringer's Immortals 18, Genghis's Army 16.
Ardashir uses Blaze of Glory on himself (+1 AR and FR) and the Empire requisitions another Shieldbearer squad. Genghis spends 4 CP on Secure Objective for the Tamga-Bound.

Ardashir destroys Stormrider 1 on his own, 18 HP. The Immortals wound the Black Shaman. The burning takes 2 off Genghis, 4 off the Khesig Guards, and destroys the Tamga-Bound in the centre. The Empire completes SECURE THE FLANKS (+2).
Genghis and the Khesig Guards charge at (6,7), back into the burning centre; the Immortals charge at (12,8). The Adur Furnace Guard's Overwatch takes 8 HP off a Tamga-Bound squad.

Genghis destroys Sagdid Hound-Keepers 1. Shieldbearers 1 destroy the Black Shaman, a CHARACTER: ASSASSINATION (+4). The burning destroys another Tamga-Bound squad and, in the Cleanup Phase, the Khesig Guards.
Genghis completes KING OF THE HILL (+3); the Empire scores ERADICATE THE FOE and crosses 30. Flamebringer's Immortals 34, Genghis's Army 25.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.html:
The Immortals win, and win the trade

Flamebringer's Immortals won 5 of the 6 battles, on average 33.2 VP to 21.7. They won every source: objectives 20.5 to 14.0 a battle, the Primary 5.3 to 2.3, the secondaries 7.3 to 5.3. The trade was lopsided: the Empire dealt 106.3 damage a battle and lost 35.3 RP; the Khaganate dealt 30.8 and lost 114.3, more than half its army. Genghis's one win was on Twin Lakes, 39 to 27.

{{batch}}{{chart:batch-vp}}{{chart:batch-sources}}

Who scored

The Javidan Immortals (30 RP) scored 5.4 VP a battle, 18.0 per 100 RP, and were never destroyed; Ardashir (75 RP) 3.7, never destroyed, and in the featured battle he destroyed two Stormrider squads. The Shieldbearers (17 RP, 22 squads with requisitions) scored 3.3 a squad, 19.5 per 100 RP. For the Khaganate, Genghis (70 RP) scored 4.4 a battle; the Stormriders (20 RP) 2.3, destroyed 8 times in 12; the Tamga-Bound Troops (10 RP) 1.1, destroyed 12 times in 18.

{{chart:batch-unit-vp}}{{chart:batch-unit-vp-rp}}

What the AI did with them

  • Alchemical Vial, twice a round. The Shieldbearers used their Vial (+1 MS, BS and DEF this round, 2 charges) 32 times, and 16 of those were a second Vial on the same unit in the same round. A second Vial only refreshes the first, so it changed nothing and threw a charge away. Fixed after this batch: the AI now prices a buff the unit already holds from the same source at nothing.
  • Standing in the fire. Sunburst's BURNING FIELD covered the centre objective from Round 4 of the featured battle, and the Khaganate kept charging back into it to hold the centre; the burning destroyed the Khesig Guards and two Tamga-Bound squads.
  • Commands that bought nothing: Judgement of the Sun (3 of 3), Genghis's Double Time (7 of 7), Chant of the Kindling 11 of 18.
  • The Adur Furnace Guard were idle 4.0 Battle Rounds a battle and the Immortals 3.2, mostly standing on objectives they were holding.
{{chart:batch-unit-inaction}}

How sure

Five to one, with the losing side losing more than half its RP each battle, is a clear result: the Immortals and Ardashir out-fought everything the Khaganate sent at them, and the Khaganate's cheap units died faster than they scored.

closing: The Khaganate's light cavalry and Tamga-Bound charged into the Immortals and died. That is the losing-fight charge from today's findings: worth replaying once the charge pricing changes. And a burning field over an objective is worth a look at how the AI weighs the hazard against holding the ground.
